geoLens.title: Courier and coverage
geoLens.sub: From your own parcels in the period: how often the courier delivered, how many came late against the delivery band's promise, and the courier that did best there. Advice only: it changes no courier rule, booking or mapping.
geoLens.noBest: No courier has enough parcels yet
geoLens.none: No parcels were delivered or returned here in this period.
geoLens.gapsSub: Places that had orders in the period but no courier is mapped to them (or to the place above them).
geoLens.gapsNone: Every place with orders has a courier.
geoLens.unknownOrders: {n} orders have no area and are not in the list above.
